messages.displayText:
I’ll fix anything a Pokémon
damages in no time!

If you want to get to know someone, just ask
them what their favorite Pokémon is.

Wouldn’t it be awesome if there was a school
where we only learned about Pokémon stuff?

I guess so...but wouldn’t it be even worse if you
ended up failing?

Geez, way to kill the vibe. ’Sides, maybe there’s
something we could learn by losing.
Fire-type moves get weaker if it’s raining!

And Water-type moves become stronger in the
rain... It might be worth keeping in mind.

Here I am, completely taken by the
recipes I was trying to steal...

I might seem fancy, but wait
until you get to know me...

Pokémon are such powerful creatures, and yet for
some reason they listen to us in battle...

Pokémon moves are fun just
to watch, don’t you think?

There are more and more wild zones... I wonder if
there’s some sort of pattern to them?

Look, I’m sorry, I really am! But I swear I told you
this already...

Hey, Prism Tower’s under construction! You
should at least do research before planning trips!

Youths have potential, old folks
have experience. Both are good!

Could we get away with charging
<U+E300>100,000 for a cup of coffee? <U+0010><U+0002>봊
Text_icon1

I should help out with Mable’s research to get
some of those TMs she hands out.

Come ooonnn, let’s trade Pokémon! I’ll even send
over my Weedle!

I’m happy to trade, but I dunno if giving away my
Ampharos for a Weedle is fair...

Don’t be afraid to use a Potion
on your Pokémon during battle.

Now, which stand was it
that stocks those Berries...?

Trying to choose which Berry to
give my Pokémon unnerves me...

I don’t need to be a hero as long
as I can help the folks in this city.

Police officers should be able to
have cute partners too, right?

I wonder what happens to Pokémon that are used
by bad Trainers to do bad things?

I’d say it’s the Trainers who should get punished
if they make their Pokémon do bad things.

I found a lost Pokémon,
so I came to drop it off.

Policing, huh... You know, that might be the job
for me if I want to show off my skills as a Trainer.

Running empties your mind. It
brings you closer to nothingness.

I help deliver information
about the city!

Isn’t it a blast battling with all
sorts of different Pokémon?

We’ll need to battle effectively no matter what
kind of Pokémon are on our teams.<U+0010><U+0001>븁
Our undercover mission depends on it!

I don’t think anyone would look at
me and guess I’m a cop.

Cafés are great for gathering info.
I’ll be the perfect waitress!

It’s nice to see so many Pokémon roaming about,
but I worry we people might run out of space...

It’s tough being a cop in a city where we all live
with Pokémon. Rookies need to work hard.
All roads lead to Prism Tower.

What makes a Pokémon strong? Working
together with its Trainer, maybe?

Bringing out your Pokémon’s full potential is a
vital skill for a Trainer, that’s for sure.

It’s best to overdo
things just a little bit!

My Pikachu’s been having tummy
troubles recently. I’m worried...

I have my Pokémon use moves to wake me up.
Sometimes I almost end up in an eternal sleep...

Wouldn’t you like to
visit Shutterbug Café?

Sure, but I won’t shut up about
photography. You know that, right?

I accidentally come off as rude
when I speak a foreign language...

If you’re in a foreign region and around people
you don’t know, just have a Pokémon battle.<U+0010><U+0001>븀
You’ll make friends in no time.

I hear they’re cutting prices to
keep people from leaving the city.

I’ve got my Pokémon with me now,
but my parents’ll come pick me up.

“Adventure”... That word
has such a nice ring to it.
I wanna do something big!

How about we go look for
Legendary Pokémon?

We don’t even know
where we’d find any!

Well, that’s why we need to look!
You gotta dream big, y’know!

I don’t know the name of the tune
they play around town, but I like it!

What’d happen if the wild zones broke down? It’s
too terrifying to even imagine!

One minute late, one day late...
Same difference, am I right?

Why is it we can only carry six
Pokémon with us at a time?!

Defeat me, and I’ll grant your wish. But I won’t go
easy on you just because you’re my child!

I know your Pokémon, and that means I can plan
a way to counter them, Dad!

It’s not a bad idea to train up your Pokémon,
whether there are wild zones around or not.
Thanks for always helping me train my Pokémon.

Rolling lets you evade moves, but it’s slower than
dashing!

It wasn’t that long ago we had to use PCs to
access the Boxes where we kept our Pokémon!

Some Pokémon need to be in
battle to really shine!

I want to eat my fill of food that
gives me lots of energy!

For dinner, I’d like to go out...
but for this battle, I’m going all in!

Win or lose, our Pokémon
should still get a feast!

I won’t bet my dinner on a
battle, but I’ll bet my honor!

I’m more interested in the commentary than the
battle itself. I’m here for the play-by-play!

Well, they seem to be battling over what to have
for dinner. At the end of the day, though, I’d say<U+0010><U+0001>븀
the mother will have the final word...

My Pokémon are too cute. I spend
the whole day just admiring them.

Now where did I put
my roller skates...?

Who’s more important—your
loved ones or your Pokémon?

You can’t just ask
people that kind of thing!

It’s not that I want to win.
I just don’t want to lose.
We’re going to take on wild zones as a family!

We’re gonna catch strong Pokémon and then
climb the ranks of the Z-A Royale!

Once we get to Rank A, we’re gonna go on a trip
around the world!

I hope my friend back
home is doing OK...

There’ve been more Pokémon-related incidents
lately. But that’s the cost of coexisting.

My Rotom Phone is
always in sleep mode.

There are actually more nocturnal
Pokémon than you’d imagine.
A lot of collectors are all about Shiny Pokémon.

Ahhh, Aromatisse...
Such an alluring name.

I haven’t had the Perilous Soup
from the Juice Shoppe in a while...

Poké Balls let you catch Pokémon. And they’re so
cheap!
Personally, I prefer the design of Ultra Balls.

I finish task after task, and yet
there’s always more work...

Lumiose Press is closing too, eh? The industry’s
truly in a slump.

They’re not closing, dear. The editors are just
working at a café around here.

Five years ago, I was what
you’d call a punk guy.

Every time I turn a corner, I like to imagine I might
bump into my favorite person or a Pokémon I like.

Promotion matches can happen
at any hour of the day, I hear.

A battle in the heart of the city!
What a spectacle that was!

Is there anything more worthwhile
than encounters with Pokémon?

I won’t get poisoned if I brush up against a
Poison-type Pokémon, will I?

So I can only have six Pokémon
with me at a time, huh?

It’d be really confusing trying to
give orders to a whole crowd.

A Trainer needs to cherish each
and every member of their team.

Boy, I’m beat. Today’s been as long
as a day without bread, you know?

If they keep setting up more wild zones, this will
eventually be the Pokémon’s city—not ours.

It doesn’t matter if you mess up during practice.
It’s all to make sure you don’t mess up in battle!

Gosh, I’m bored... I guess it
beats being too busy, though. <U+0010><U+0002>봊
Text_icon1

It’s so weak and yet it survives...
Magikarp is cool like that.
Life finds a way.

I don’t want to lose to any kid!
There’s no deep reason why!

When you see a large Pokémon stretching, it’s
impossible not to say, “That’s a big stretch!”

“Hard to stay in love”?
Please, I make it easy.

It’s easy to fall in love,
but hard to stay in love.

I wanna use
Fire types!

Think I’ll go with
Water types.

Then I’ll pick
Grass types!
I’ll be Electric!

I wonder if Pokémon ever show up in front of
people because they want to be caught?

You never know! Maybe your Swirlix was thinking
just that sort of thing when it showed up.

Poké Puffs sure
are delicious, huh?

With Pokémon around, I’m
twice as happy and half as sad!

Though battling with just one
Pokémon can be tough...

Let’s head home
right at quitting time.

Mais oui! Overworking ourselves
simply lets others relax more!

I really want to become Rank A in the Z-A Royale.
Maybe I should just move here to Lumiose...

I used to be just a tourist, but then I found I really
enjoy traveling. Now I’m a full-time backpacker!

Lumiose isn’t perfect, but it’s still a great city. It’s
my job to make sure it stays that way.

I’m going to live my life without
being afraid of being happy!

Maybe a nice, cute Spinarak
could help draw in customers...

When you love someone, at first you can forgive
a lot. But then the things you can’t forgive start<U+0010><U+0001>븀
adding up, precisely because you care so much.

The Kalos region is famous for its circuses!
Lately, the cirque contemporain style is very in.<U+0010><U+0001>븀
The performances are amazing!

During Z-A Royale matches, weak Trainers tend to
stay near Pokémon Centers.

People, Pokémon... We’re all going to die
someday, aren’t we?
That’s really sad...

Just because everyone’s doing
something doesn’t make it right.

Pokémon help me stay happy
each and every day! <U+0010><U+0002>봊
Text_icon1

That furisode looks gorgeous, but it must be a
pain to take care of...

I take it to a specialist cleaner. I hear they rely on
Pokémon to help with the work.

Pokémon battles after work are the one thing I
truly enjoy.<U+0010><U+0001>븁
Wait...that’s not true! I also enjoy my dear
Pokémon’s company!

Cheese sandwiched in a fresh baguette! I’ve got
no complaints in life as long as I’ve got this!

Here’s your lunch! Try not to forget it at home
next time!

I’m a member of the Pokédex Research Society. If
I were to write Sliggoo’s entry, I’d say...<U+0010><U+0001>븁
“This Pokémon covers itself in a membrane that
dissolves anything. Sliggoo will even try to<U+0010><U+0001>븀
dissolve those it becomes friendly with.”

My partner Pokémon is with me everywhere I go,
but nowhere we go is actually home to us...

Want to try swapping
places with me?

No way! What if Lady
Jacinthe caught me?!

A human can’t defeat a Pokémon,
no matter how much they train.

I’m surveying the area to see if we can place a
Holovator around here.

I heard about a tunnel with lotsa
dangerous Pokémon deep inside.

I hear people who go in
never come back out...
You two should go explore!

I’ll follow my savior’s example
and help the less fortunate.

Back when I was a kid, I got into trouble trying to
go into tall grass without a Pokémon.

Even as an adult I’ve been told to be careful
whenever I enter a wild zone.

Who is La Primera...? I heard she can bring out
the full potential of any Pokémon...

I say what I mean. No
one can read minds.

If words elude you, there’s
always Pokémon battling!

It tickles the imagination when you overhear
conversations walking around town, right?

I know what you mean. I sometimes try and
guess what kind of Pokémon they have.

I end up eavesdropping. It’s like I get a sneak
peek into a world I don’t know!

I came down using the ladder, but...it seems like
I’ve hit a dead end.

Hmm... This might be a good spot for training—if
my Pokémon likes it, that is.

The city keeps changing over time. I just hope my
favorite views stay the same.

Everyone changes their thinking
after they’ve had a good meal.

You always flip-flop on
your opinions, don’t you?

Oh, don’t worry. This is my first time instructing
someone too!

This is my first Pokémon battle. I’m counting on
you to give me good instructions!

I wonder if it’s safe to drink Clauncher’s Water
Gun?

Once I sit down on a bench, I can
hardly make myself get up!

Time passes extra fast
when you’re on a bench.

I wonder what the deal
was with Team Flare?

I want a Pokémon that’s strong and also looks
really cool.

I hear the police are even busier these days
thanks to the increase in wild Pokémon.

I make deliveries during my break.
That’s just how I like to work.

I may not look it, but I’m Rank Q.
I’m in a bit of a slump, though...
Do you think Pokémon like sitting on benches?

I’m really curious about this
one regular’s Clauncher...

You can’t idolize something
you know nothing about.

I’m so tired during the day...
All ’cause of the Z-A Royale...

If I’m by myself, I ride Pokémon.
But a car’s the best for a crowd.

The order of the Pokémon on your team is pretty
important, you know?

Even your strongest Pokémon can’t keep winning
forever, after all.

Do you send out your ace at the beginning? Or do
you keep it as a finisher?

Some battles boil down to which Pokémon you
send out.

I want to have my Pokémon sing
and for everyone to listen.

I feel like I could do anything with
the power of my Pokémon.

I’m going to add the first Pokémon
I meet today to my team.

Who has time to be bored when you’re people
watching and Pokémon watching?

People will do some crazy things when they get
hungry. So do Pokémon, actually.

Good coffee doesn’t need a
sign to advertise itself.

Mega Shards! We need to get as many Mega
Shards as we can, y’hear?

On the wrong side of the law? Just make sure you
stay on the right side of Pokémon!

“Eyes! Aim for the eyes!” Those
were my brother’s last words...

If ya haven’t noticed, I’m a member of the Rust
Syndicate. Why d’you keep buggin’ me like this?

I like how you battle with your Pokémon! I could
tell you really care for them.

Nobody wants to start trouble
so long as ya look tough.

It’s not like we do anythin’.
We just stand around.

I feel bad for Pokémon
that have evil Trainers...

I get a bit nervous anytime
I see a cop strollin’ around...

You need to think carefully about which four
moves you’ll teach your Pokémon.

Gotta earn money so I can
feed my lovely Pokémon!

Some people get real arrogant just
’cause they have strong Pokémon.
Then I’m already stronger than the Champion!

In order to become a strong Trainer, the first step
is to really love your Pokémon.

There are a lot of different types of collectors.
Some see it as a duty, some just like to compete...

The acting director of the research
lab... I swear I’ve seen her before.

I’m gonna help with Mable’s
research and get a TM.

Taking walks with my Pokémon
helps me feel energized.

Funny how our company’s woes
go away if the bottom line goes up.

No human could withstand
Weedle’s Poison Sting.

I want to set up a trapeze
between these buildings.

Practice helps build familiarity. Familiarity helps
you stay calm.

Pokémon raised by people are stronger than wild
Pokémon. I wonder if that means Pokémon use<U+0010><U+0001>븀
people to become stronger?

I can’t go anywhere without
my Pokémon these days.

Pokémon are the ones running
the show at work. At home, too...
Watch us grunts wash away the rust! ♪
We clean the city of dirt and dust! ♪

Have you got business with the Rust Syndicate?
If not, buzz off!
Hey! Keep up the good work for Lumiose!

I don’t say anything about
myself unless I’m asked.

Living with Pokémon does make
me a little conscious of their smell.
There’s a local Ace Trainer who helps me out.

How do you learn about Pokémon? Me, I look up
stuff online.

Sometimes the most precious
moments are during wasted time.

I wish my Pokémon could deliver
this, but then I’d be out of a job.

Even an ordinary meal is
special if it’s in Lumiose.

I don’t have time for Pokémon battles. I’m too
busy with tennis!

I go to judo classes with my Pokémon. We
practice together.

It’s better to throw everything
away than let junk tie you down!

I can’t remember... What was my
dream when I was younger...?

Why is it my moves always seem to miss at the
most crucial moment?

As the Trainer, you’ve got the power to pick moves
with a lower chance of missing.

Some high-powered moves end up missing the
opponent a lot of the time...<U+0010><U+0001>븁
It’s hard to know when to use moves like that and
when to play it safe!

My Pokémon
ran away...

Things were so bad between you
a Poké Ball wouldn’t help, huh?

I wanna use Pokémon moves! I wanna use
Flamethrower!

A city where nobody knows me...
Choosing to be alone is freeing.

Is it too much to ask for a spot
of my own in this big city?!

My partner Gengar keeps looking at me like I’m
its prey...

C’mon... You’ve gotta tell me... How in the world
do you get a Gengar?!<U+0010><U+0001>븁
It can’t be... It’s inconceivable!<U+0010><U+0001>븁
You must have a friend who will trade Pokémon
with you!

I don’t know how you all can tell which Pokémon
is in which Poké Ball.

Is the Pokémon Rotom really inside my Rotom
Phone?!

I caught my partner when it
wandered into my home!

If I ever get lost, I know I can
just aim for Prism Tower.

My greatest foe in the Z-A Royale
is my lack of sleep... So drowsy...

Doing the right thing doesn’t always mean you’ll
get the right results. Why? Because life is unfair.

Let’s battle before I paint!
A win will surely inspire me!

All it takes to go on a journey is a pinch of
curiosity! Really, that’s it!

This is just everyday wear for me, but I guess it’s
pretty unusual to people from far away.
Can I take your picture?
The latest fashion of Lumiose!

People and Pokémon all have
their strengths and weaknesses.

Night patrols are frightening, even for an officer.
Pokémon cries and other noises all around...

If only my dear Gogoat could
carry me and my packages...

Torn between a fit you love and
one that suits you? Both are good!

I tried to throw a Poké Ball,
only to hurt my shoulder...

Pokémon battle skills are part of what you need to
succeed in corporate life!

Pokémon don’t need to be strong. All they need to
do is keep me company when life’s hard...

I plan on booking an entire
beauty salon for my Pokémon.

Moves that miss a lot
are unreliable in a pinch.

I just ate, and yet here I am
thinking about my next meal...

I’m really good at dodging attacks!
Though I wish I didn’t have to...

I’ve heard there’s this gang in
Lumiose that helps out Emma.

I wonder how many steps it’d
take to walk around Lumiose?

I totally show it on my face whenever I’m up
against a type I know I can’t beat in battle...<U+0010><U+0001>븀
then I get beat in no time by my opponent.

I guess part of growing up is learning to play it
cool. For now, maybe you need a new strategy?

Do you think the benches around here can hold
even really heavy Pokémon?

Benches are nice. Sometimes you just need to
take a break.

If the Pokémon really wanted to, they could
destroy Lumiose in no time...
Why do you work?

Don’t get me wrong, I like money.
But really, I just enjoy my job.

Where do Pokémon come from?
And where do they go?

Just because everyone else does
something doesn’t mean I have to.

Big-picture stuff is beyond me.
I just leave it to the visionaries.

I wish I could’ve made one
of those Trainer PR Videos...

As a Pokémon Trainer, what do I need to do to
win battles?

If you want to get stronger, the best thing to do is
level up your Pokémon!

Would you happen to know
of a man called Mr. Bonding?

Really? I just straight up challenge them to a
battle so I can see whose Pokémon is stronger.

If I see someone walking around with the same
Pokémon as me, I can’t help but say hi!

Should we book rooms at
Hotel Richissime after all?

That promo video for Hotel Z
was...a bit cringey, wasn’t it?

It certainly had passion
and energy, but yeah...

It’s tough finding the energy for Pokémon battles
day after day...<U+0010><U+0001>븁
Especially once you become a working adult
trying to hold down a job.

I see... That’s certainly something.
(How am I supposed to respond to that...?)

Me and my partner Pokémon get along TOO well.
I must’ve been a Pokémon in my past life!

I’m a member of the Pokédex Research Society!<U+0010><U+0001>븁
Let’s see... If I were to write Weedle’s entry
myself, I would put down something like...<U+0010><U+0001>븁
“If Weedle is no longer able to live in a tree where
it has made its home, it will seek another tree to<U+0010><U+0001>븀
live in, using its red nose to find one that it likes.”

There are so many Pokémon now
that it’s changed the city’s smell.

An installation piece!
The space is the art!

I always sleep better
on a tatami bed.

I deliver not just information
about the city, but also...love!

Someday I’m gonna take on Ingo
and Emmet on the Multi Train!

I don’t know, but maybe someday we’ll have to
battle an AI Champion.

Do you think we’d win all our battles if we asked
an AI for instructions?

If you’re too weak as a Trainer, your partner
Pokémon will get sad.

I’m an ordinary man by day, but by
night...I’m still an ordinary man.

Think a weakened Thunderbolt
could be used for a massage?

Whenever I’m lonely, I talk to
my Pokémon in their Poké Balls.

I’m glad to have travel recommendations, but
should I be finding my own experiences instead?

There are a lot more wild Pokémon around lately,
right? I’ve heard they’ve been fighting over food.

In a city this big, I bet I could
find a doppelgänger of myself!

Whatever happened to that
news anchor lady, Malva?

The Rust Syndicate folks
are really nice to me!

Look at how long we’ve been together... And it all
started because we liked the same Pokémon.

To think, I’d never have met her at all if I didn’t
happen to send Meowstic into battle that day...

What’s the point of a
day off if you don’t rest?

It’s hard to come by, but Skiddo
cheese is quite the delicacy.

Even if you reach that point where you can’t seem
to beat your opponents anymore, you can always<U+0010><U+0001>븀
have fun with your Pokémon.

My customers are more interested in what I bring
them than they are in the guy bringing it.<U+0010><U+0001>븀
I know that. But still...

The best souvenirs to bring home from a trip are
surely Pokémon from the region you’re visiting!

Think I’ll grab some fruit from the
corner shop before I head home.

Furisode have such long sleeves. It’s really
unbe-sleeve-able!<U+0010><U+0001>븁
...Elesa taught me that joke herself, OK?

I’m going to find and read each
and every Trainer Tips board!

I think I’ll try an underhand throw
next time I toss a Poké Ball.

Pokémon with a good sense of smell are great as
police Pokémon.

Iris versus Drayton? Now that’d be a match worth
watching!

“I don’t have the talent” is what
people afraid of hard work say!

No talent? You can compensate
with knowledge and experience!
TO BE DELETED
TO BE DELETED

When I catch a Pokémon, I become its “OT,” right?
What does that mean?

That stands for Original Trainer. It just means that
you were the person who caught that Pokémon!

There’s so much info about Pokémon! It’s easy to
get overwhelmed unless you think for yourself.

My customers teach me all I need
to know about cooking well. <U+0010><U+0002>봊
Text_icon1

Time to Roto-Glide! That’s right!
I’ll be soaring through the sky!

If you’re drained from work,
microwave meals save time.

I wonder if it’s really a Trainer’s duty to cheer on
a battling Pokémon even when it can’t win...

You feel happy when someone’s cheering for you,
right? I bet it’s the same for Pokémon.

The air is cleaner in high places, and it’s so quiet.
It’s really the best place to be.

The only drawback about spending time on the
rooftop is that you have to go back down.

People flock to me when
I send my Pokémon out!

They’re interested in your
Pokémon, not you...

I wanna chase the Pokémon
flying above Lumiose!

That’s not how you do it!
Get them to chase you!

I’ll rise through the Z-A Royale ranks and prove
that I’m worthy of taking over my dad’s company!

DYN4MO has plenty of female members, but the
whole group just seems so intense...

We’d have to get you one of those
Mega Rings from Quasartico then.

I really wanna Mega Evolve
my Garchomp in battle.

Then what about those rumors
of a Floette with a black flower?

Floette can be found holding
a flower in one of five colors!

There’s red and yellow, and then
orange and blue and white, yeah?

The move Heavy Slam deals more damage the
heavier the Pokémon using it is!

Why do Pokémon become small and go into
Poké Balls?

The purpose of life is
simply to enjoy living.

With my partner Pokémon
at my side, I feel invincible!

Hmm, we’re almost out of money... There aren’t
too many people battling during the day here.

I heard you can make some decent money by
participating in the Z-A Royale!

Watching you battle is always informative, Sis. I
may have some notes for you, though.

Well, we can discuss it over dinner, my
dependable coach.

Ugh! I totally woke up on the
wrong side of the bed today!

I’m thinking I’ll visit all five plazas here in
Lumiose City.

One victory’s all you need to feel good, even if
you’ve lost a hundred times. Kinda unfair, isn’t it?

I’m going to invent a new dance
style inspired by Pokémon moves!

Who designed the Rust Syndicate
HQ? What were they thinking?

Better keep that kind
of opinion to yourself.

The trick to not getting lost in Lumiose is using
your map. Not much of a secret, I know.

Pokémon don’t always listen
to the orders you give them?

It’s for the best, really.
Some orders are pretty bad.

The Pokémon always wake me
up in the morning... Always...

Who needs to follow trends when you can just
come up with your own style?

What should we get for
our second Pokémon?
A cool Pokémon!

Something that covers your first
Pokémon’s weaknesses, maybe?

Any kind is all right, as long
as you take good care of it!

Hey, for Water-type moves, do you think Pokémon
use their sweat? Or other bodily fluids?
My Delibird and I had a fateful encounter!

I’m thinking about retiring, to be honest. I’m no
good to my partner if I can’t win battles...

Do what feels right to you. Just remember, you
can retire any time.

I really want to move,
but the rent is just...

I know. Goods may get cheaper,
but rent just doesn’t go down.

Hey, I think we should follow a
